system.description: • Effect: +1 flat bonus damage per two Ranger levels against humanoids (bugbears, gnolls, goblins, hobgoblins, kobolds, orcs, and similar), giants (giants, ogres, and similar), and — once marked, or once a kit extends the list — other qualifying creature types. Against any other creature, the bonus is +1 per four Ranger levels.

rules.when: vs humanoids, giants and marked or kit-listed creatures
